strings.subtitle: — Qillqanak chhaqtayaña —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Wayuña jan ukax uchaña janiw utjkiti. Aka patañ chimpu apnaqaña.
strings.shred_button: C H H A Q T A Y A
strings.ssd_warning:
Jark'aqt'awi! SSD-n TRIM layku qillqt'awi thakhix chhaqtayañ janiw katuqkaniti.
Aka lurawix HDD-takiwa.
strings.confirm_text:
Qillqa "{name}" patxaru qillqt'atawa ukhamarak apaqatawa.

Sarantañsa?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS yaqha yatiyawi thakhi (ADS) janiw apnaqaskiti.
• USN panka janiw q'umachaskiti.
• Ch'iwkhata katilla ukhamarak qinaya uñtatawi
  (OneDrive yaqhanakampi) janiw chhaqtayaskiti.
strings.status_full: Utjiri yatiyawix taqpiruw ch'usampi patxaru qillqt'ata. Kutt'ayañax janiw wakiskiti — apnaqawinakax ch'usa ukaki uñjapxi.
strings.status_fast: P'iqi, ch'akha ukhamarak 4 MB t'aqanakax patxaru qillqt'atawa. Yaqha janiw llamt'atakiti, ukampis jutiri tuqinak layku, phuqhata kutt'ayawix apnaqiri apnaqawinakampi janiw wakiskiti. Imanta qillqanakataki PHAQ'A modo apnaqaña.
strings.status_empty: Qillqax ch'usawa, patxaru qillqt'añax janiw wakiskänti. Apqatwa.
strings.error_permission: Qillqaru mantañax janiw wakiskiti. Yaqha lurawin mantañapachax wakisi. Jist'antaña ukhamarak mayampi yant'aña.
strings.error_not_found: Qillqax janiw jikxatatakiti. Nayraqata apaqata wakisi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Aka chimpumpi thakhix siñalawa. Siñalanakax janiw chhaqtayaskiti — amtawi qillqax qhana qhiparakiwa.
strings.error_reparse: Aka kikpa uñstaw qillqawa (OneDrive jan ukax kikpa). Yatiyawipax qinayankiwa, janiw t'aqa pampan utjkiti — akanx janiw chhaqtayañatakixa utjkiti.
strings.error_not_file: Aka janiw qillqakiti (jiwasa jan ukax yaqha). Mä qillqa jaytaña.
strings.error_hardlinks: Aka qillqax yaqha thakhi thuru (jach'a) utji ({n} taqpacha). Thuru thakhinakax janiw p'iqi utjkiti — taqi sutinakax kikpakiwa. Jichha thakhin apaqata, yatiyawix patxaru qillqt'ataw 32 byte-ru khuchutäni, ukampis qhipiri yaqha thakhinakan jikxatasiñjamarakiwa. Nayraqata taqi thakhinaka apaqaña.
strings.error_compressed:
Qillqax ch'iqatatäwa, imantatäwa jan ukax pisinawa. Ch'usa patxaru qillqt'añax mä mara yatiyawinak chhaqtayañ janiw katuqkaniti, NTFS yaqha thakhinakampi imantaskchix.

Chimpu apaqaña: kupi ch'ijtawi → Chimpunaka → Jach'a → chimpu "Ch'iqata" ukhamarak "Imanta" apaqaña. Ukatxa SHREDDER mayampi apnaqaña.
strings.queue_hint: (jan ukax qillqanaka aka uñjawi ukaru wayt'aña)
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} qillqanaka chhaqhaña.
Taqpacha jach'a: {size}.

Qhawqha qillqanaka uñakipam.
Aka lurañajja janiw kutt'añjamäkiti.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Taqpacha {count} qillqanaka qullqata apaqaña?

Qillqanakajja janiw kankañapkiti — qullqaki.
strings.hardlink_text:
Qillqa "{name}" juk'ampi ch'iqachawinakaniwa ({nlink} taqpacha).

Taqpacha sutinakatakiw datos chhaqhasi.
Ukhamarak 32 bytes qhipharaqani.

Aka qhipharäwinaka amparampi pichsuñamawa.
